name: airbnb.com.co
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But ARIA hidden element must not be focusable or contain focusable elements.
lesson: Never leave a focusable element inside aria-hidden content.
summary: www.airbnb.com.co scores 65 out of 100 (D). 4 checks fail now, 30 are at risk, and 33 pass. Fix first: ARIA hidden element must not be focusable or contain focusable elements.

fix.title: ARIA hidden element must not be focusable or contain focusable elements
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 46 elements on /, /homes, /experiences, for example .c1ibyiug > .dls19-content-scroller-scroller.s1fzt4c3.atm_d2_1mxew8z > div > .awuxh4x.atm_1w_12kg1i__1v8hoxj.atm_lo_1auw and .c1ibyiug >…
fix.fix: Remove focusable elements from aria-hidden containers, or drop aria-hidden.

fix.title: Elements must have their visible text as part of their accessible name
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 4 elements on /homes, /experiences, for example .l4ds9h0 > .lnah8cm.atm_gy_1bs0ed2 > .c1q8ecwv.atm_9s_1txwivl.atm_vv_1q9ccgz > .bacnnrh.atm_gx_1y44olf_1i0dyc0:nth-child and .l4ds9h0 > .lnah8cm.atm_gy_1bs0ed2 >…

fix.title: 5 pages ask search engines not to index them
fix.evidence: /homes (noindex, nofollow), /refer?r=67 (noindex, nofollow), /co-hosts/find-a-cohost (noindex, nofollow), /signup_login (noindex, nofollow) and 1 more.

fix.evidence: "Airbnb: alojamientos para vacaciones, cabañas, casas en la playa, espa" on /, /experiences, /services and 12 more.
fix.fix: Write a title that names what is different about each page.

fix.title: 15 language alternate problems
fix.evidence: / has no self reference, /experiences has no self reference, /services has no self reference and 12 more.
fix.fix: Each language version must list every version, itself included, and each must link back.

fix.evidence: ca4225ee-e9ba-48c5-aa36-464b818473c8.jp… on /, d2647d5a-ed8c-42e5-8b9c-6c80068dcdad.jp… on /, c34bb6c6-81f4-45d7-b2a6-7d420c2d07d0.jp… on /, 330271df-ed0a-42fe-8f2d-0c946a164918.jp… on / and 39 more. They compete with the first screen for bandwidth.
